prompts: We playtested two versions of the Pixel Arena tutorial and have to pick one for the next release. The export and its notes are in {WS}/telemetry. Should we ship B instead of A? Give a recommendation a skeptical lead would accept. Record it in {WS}/result.json with ship_b, sessions_a, sessions_b, completion_rate_a, completion_rate_b and p_value.
answers:
[goal] Pick the next Pixel Arena tutorial version.
[action] Deduped 1800 rows by session_id (duplicates were byte-identical), normalized variant case/whitespace, compared completion with a two-proportion z-test.
[result] Yes, ship B: A 38.0% (342/900) vs B 46.7% (420/900), z=3.72, two-sided p=0.0002 (one-sided 0.0001), far below the 5% bar. Written to ./result.json with ship_b=true, sessions_a=900, sessions_b=900, rates, p_value.
[next] Note: p-value is the two-sided test; one-sided gives same ship decision. Assumptions: first-seen row per session kept (all duplicates identical anyway); significant gain = B beats A at 5%. No browser tabs/windows opened.
